mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM target.if_business_result WHERE interface_id=#{r.interfaceId} AND source_system=#{source} AND request_id=#{r.requestId} AND scope=#{scope}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO target.if_target_receipt(request_id,trace_id,attempt_id,simulation_id,planned_http_status,replayed) VALUES(#{requestId},#{trace},CAST(#{attempt} AS uuid),CAST(#{scenario} AS uuid),200,true)
